changes.comment: Remove the speculative `list_peers` channel capability (issue #209): the optional `ChannelSession.listPeers?` method and the `ChannelListPeersInput` type are removed from the public channel contract. They were never an owner-designed capability and had no implementation; external channel providers do not need to declare or implement peer enumeration. The rest of the `ChannelSession` contract (`reply` / `react` / `resolveTarget` / `tools` / `handleTool` / `messageBelongsToTarget`) is unchanged.
